home.tagline: A world of exceptional fragrances and the great olfactory signatures. Chosen one by one, delivered across all 58 wilayas.

home.houseBody: Born of a passion for noble trails, Dar Safia brings together the greatest creations of world perfumery and extraits of masterful concentration. Every bottle is chosen on strict criteria: purity of accords, wear on the skin, certified authentic provenance.

manifesto.body: A trail is not chosen in a display case. It is recognised — across a room, on a coat, years later. Dar Safia gathers the creations capable of that: the ones whose trace outlives the moment.
manifesto.aside: Every bottle is held to three demands: purity of accords, wear on the skin, and verified provenance.

scent.title: The materials that recur
scent.body: Across the house's {count} creations, a few materials appear more than the rest. Without anyone deciding it, they draw the taste of Dar Safia.

about.metaDescription: Dar Safia doesn't sell perfumes, it keeps them. The stance, the three selection requirements, and the house concierge.
title: A house,
not a shelf.
about.lead: Dar Safia doesn't sell perfumes — it keeps them. Every bottle in the catalogue passed through the same hands, set aside or kept against criteria that don't move.
about.stanceBody: More fragrances are released each year than a lifetime could wear. Most of them blur together. Our work starts there: read, smell, compare, and show only what holds over time — not what sells best in the first week.
about.stanceAside: A tight selection is a service, not a limit: it's time handed back to you.

requirements.detail: A composition that holds together, with no shrill note and no synthetic shortcut. What you smell on the first spray should still make sense an hour later.
A trail that carries through the day. Low concentrations and eaux that fade in two hours don't make the cut.
Authentic bottles, tracked from the original house to you. No grey market, no counterfeit — non-negotiable.

about.conciergeBody: Advice happens on WhatsApp, with a person — not a form. We point you to what will suit you, even if that means telling you a perfume isn't for you. Payment is on delivery, across all 58 wilayas.
